data.description: Deterministic MCP task API with versioned task mutations. Contract v2 list retrieval queries SQL summary columns only: id, number, title bounded to 240 characters with titleTruncated, state and version. Default page size 25, maximum 100; filteredTotal, hasMore and nextCursor make completeness explicit. Omitted/null states selects all; [] selects none; exact schema enums open, finished and confirmed reject invalid filters. Keyset cursors bind project, normalized states and project revision; stale cursors fail and require restart. Full detail and linked design remain in get_task. Creates use unique task identity; update, finish and delete use expected task versions. Finish remains AI-owned with completion evidence.
data.name: Task MCP API
data.technology: MCP tools, SQL, per-task optimistic concurrency
